senses.gloss: €1Ā. (चयते) To go to or towards, move.

€1U. (चायति-ते) 
__1 To observe, discern, see; तं पार्वतीयप्रमदाश्चचायिरे विकाशविस्फारितविभ्रमेक्षणाः [[Śi. 12. 51.]] 
__2 To worship, honour.

[चि-अच्] 
__1 An assemblage; collection, multitude, heap, mass; चयस्त्विषामित्यवधारितं पुरा [[Śi. 1. 3]]; मृदां चयः [[U. 2. 7]] a lump of clay; कचानां चयः [[Bh. 1. 5]] a braid of hair; so चमरीचयः [[Śi. 4. 60]]; कुसुमचय, तुषारचय &c. 
__2 A mound of earth raised to form the foundation of a building. 
__3 A mound of earth raised from the ditch of a fort. 
__4 A rampart. 
__5 The gate of a fort. 
__6 A seat, stool. 
__7 A pile of buildings, any edifice. 
__8 Stacked wood. 
__9 A cover or covering. 
__10 Arranging or keeping the sacred fire; cf. अग्निचय. 
__11 The amount by which each term increases, the common increase or difference of the terms (in a progression).

[चि भावे-ल्युट्] 
__1 The act of collecting (especially flowers &c.). 
__2 Piling, heaping. 
__3 Keeping the sacred fire. 
__4 Stacking wood.
